D: The residents of a tiny Nevada town fight giant underground worms.
P: Serve the snacks when Burt and Heather defend their basement.
S: Beef jerky, salted peanuts and pork rinds tipped into bowls, with a jar of pickled eggs on the counter.
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Rump steaks and thick sausages grilled over coals, baked beans simmered with onion and molasses, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
tinned beans and franks from the bunker
Sliced franks browned, onion, tinned beans, smoked paprika, molasses and mustard simmered 20 minutes, cornbread on the side.
W: gummy worms coming up through the dirt
Chocolate pudding set in cups, crushed chocolate biscuit dirt on top, gummy worms poking out.
K: the beer they never get to finish
American lager ice cold in cans, from the esky in the back of the truck.

s.how: Slice 600g beef topside 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Dry on racks at 70C with the oven door ajar for 4 hours until leathery.

Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, peel and pack into a jar with 250ml hot white vinegar, salt and a pinch of sugar, and chill overnight. Tip 100g jerky, 150g salted peanuts and a bag of pork rinds into bowls beside the jar.

m.how: Simmer 2 tins baked beans with a diced onion and 2 tbsp molasses for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter cabbage and toss with 100g mayo and a splash of vinegar. Grill 2 rump steaks and 4 thick sausages over hot coals and slice to share.

w.note: gummy worms coming up through the dirt
w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 3 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour in a pot over medium heat until thick. Pour into four cups and chill 2 hours. Top with 100g crushed chocolate biscuits and push gummy worms in so they poke out.

d.note: the beer they never get to finish
d.how: Fill an esky with a bag of ice and a little cold water and bury eight 375ml cans of American lager for an hour. Hand them out cold and stay off the ground.
